name: tinto-travels-plugins
description: Self-service plugin catalog for the Tinto Travels team's Cowork accounts. Two plugins are restricted to one person's daily workflow (guest communication for Nélia, supplier logistics for Tamara); every other plugin — supplier-pairing audits, hotel-block booking, rooming lists, transport itineraries, booking-page publishing, winery-record entry, client itinerary PDFs — is open to the whole team.

plugins.name: tinto-guest-communication
plugins.description: Nélia's guide to daily guest and winery-client email communications. Restricted to Nélia's daily workflow.

plugins.name: tinto-logistics
plugins.description: Tamara's guide to the daily supplier-booking check and drafting cycle. Restricted to Tamara's daily workflow.

plugins.name: tinto-confirm-supplier-pairings
plugins.description: Auditing region-matched tour-supplier pairings against real itinerary evidence, destination by destination — a standalone plugin, open to the whole team.

plugins.name: tinto-batch-book-hotel-rooms
plugins.description: Requesting seasonal hotel room holds and converting them into sold-tour bookings — a standalone plugin, open to the whole team.

plugins.name: tinto-rooming-lists
plugins.description: Producing a per-tour rooming list with passport details (English + the hotel's local language when it differs), matching Tinto's real rooming-list format, with one workbook per hotel for tours that use more than one — a standalone plugin, open to the whole team.

plugins.name: tinto-bus-company-itineraries
plugins.description: Producing a branded day-by-day transport schedule PDF for a tour's bus/driver company — a standalone plugin, open to the whole team.

plugins.name: tinto-booking-pages
plugins.description: Auditing a tour's booking-page readiness and publishing it live — a standalone plugin for whoever handles publishing, separate from Nélia's guest communication plugin.

plugins.name: tinto-add-winery-record
plugins.description: Entering an already-agreed winery client's record and branding into Airtable — a standalone plugin, installable on its own by anyone who needs it (e.g. Peter).

plugins.name: tinto-client-itinerary-pdf
plugins.description: Building the dated, tour-specific client itinerary PDF used to sell a tour — a standalone plugin, installable on its own by anyone who needs it (e.g. Peter).
